jobs.name: three_table_join_range
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id < $1 AND b.id < $1 AND c.id < $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: indexed_join
jobs.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

jobs.name: primary_many
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,b.score FROM items a LEFT JOIN items b ON b.id=a.id WHERE a.id<$1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: secondary_many
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,b.id,b.label FROM bound_probes a LEFT JOIN bound_lookup b ON b.join_key=a.join_key WHERE a.id<$1 ORDER BY a.id,b.id

jobs.name: composite_many
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id,b.id,b.label FROM bound_probes a LEFT JOIN bound_composite b ON b.grp=a.grp AND b.join_key=a.join_key WHERE a.id<$1 ORDER BY a.id,b.id
